# R1 vectors attribution

`groups-vectors.json`, `class-vectors.json` and `holders-vectors.json` are
reproduced **without changes** from the public specification at tag `v0.1.51`,
commit `bd3bc80e5543d8a563343ec05abd1a5f3f67284c`:

- [LIP-0026 groups](https://github.com/relux-works/swarma-link-spec/blob/bd3bc80e5543d8a563343ec05abd1a5f3f67284c/vectors/LIP-0026/groups-vectors.json).
- [LIP-0026 landlord class](https://github.com/relux-works/swarma-link-spec/blob/bd3bc80e5543d8a563343ec05abd1a5f3f67284c/vectors/LIP-0026/class-vectors.json).
- [LIP-0010 holders](https://github.com/relux-works/swarma-link-spec/blob/bd3bc80e5543d8a563343ec05abd1a5f3f67284c/vectors/LIP-0010/holders-vectors.json).

The upstream credits are retained by reference to that public notice. The
fixture licence is separate from this repository's Apache-2.0 code licence.
J9–J12 are in force; explicitly marked draft additions remain proposals.
These vectors confer no authority.

`row-fit-vectors.json` is a local stated-fact test fixture for LIP-0026 R2,
licensed with this repository. It is not an upstream normative vector file.
